llm.summary: This is a disclosed slide-deck generator; it writes local HTML decks by default and uses OnePress network APIs when an API key is configured.

dimensions.detail: Connected mode reads ONEPRESS_API_KEY and sends the deck task to OnePress; local decks may load ECharts and Google Fonts. These network behaviors are purpose-aligned and documented, but users should treat deck prompts as shared with the service when connected mode is enabled.
dimensions.label: Credentials
dimensions.name: environment_proportionality

dimensions.detail: The artifact contains markdown instructions only, with installation described as a ClawHub install or manual placement; no bundled executable, install script, package dependency, or hidden setup behavior was found.
dimensions.label: Install Mechanism
dimensions.name: install_mechanism

dimensions.detail: The activation scope is broad within presentation work, but it is coherent for a deck-building skill and includes explicit non-trigger cases for summaries, code tasks, and spreadsheets.
dimensions.label: Instruction Scope
dimensions.name: instruction_scope

dimensions.detail: No local persistence or privilege escalation was found beyond writing the requested HTML deck. Connected mode discloses a persistent OnePress workspace and conversation context, while the API key remains in environment or config rather than chat.
dimensions.label: Persistence & Privilege
dimensions.name: persistence_privilege

dimensions.detail: The stated purpose and capabilities align: local mode builds a self-contained HTML deck, connected mode submits deck tasks to OnePress for research, export, and media features, and non-deck tasks are excluded.
dimensions.label: Purpose & Capability
dimensions.name: purpose_capability

llm.guidance: Install this if you want an agent to create slide decks. Without ONEPRESS_API_KEY it writes a local HTML file; with the key set, your prompt and follow-ups are sent to OnePress and may remain in its workspace, so avoid secrets, regulated data, or confidential business material unless that is approved for the service.
llm.findings:
[SQP-1] expected: Deck and presentation requests are an expected trigger for this skill, and the artifact includes deck-specific use cases plus non-trigger boundaries.
[SQP-2] expected: Connected mode does transmit the user's deck task to OnePress with a bearer token, but this is the documented purpose of the configured API mode; the privacy notice could be more prominent.
[EA2] unexpected: The cited text is a protective instruction not to paste API keys into chat, not evidence of autonomous destructive or high-impact action.
[SQP-3] unexpected: The default html lang template is a quality/localization issue rather than a security concern.
[SQP-2] expected: Local mode writes a new HTML deck in the user's working directory, which is expected for a deck-generation skill and is disclosed in the README and runtime instructions.
